tasks:

    script: |

    deps:

      - 'ignored-fallible-results'

    toolchains:

    command: 'bash scripts/check-ignored-fallible-results.sh'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:

      - 'scripts/check-ignored-fallible-results.sh'
      - 'scripts/ignored-fallible-results.allow'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

    script: |
      set -euo pipefail
      if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'Missing required scanner: rg\n' >&2
        exit 127
      fi
      mkdir -p target/static-audit
      unsafe_pattern='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])unsafe[[:space:]]*(\{|fn\b|trait\b|impl\b|extern\b|\()'
      log_file='target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log'
      if rg -n "$unsafe_pattern" crates --glob '*.rs' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/benches/**' --glob '!**/examples/**' --glob '!**/fixtures/**' --glob '!**/verification/**' --glob '!**/kani*/**' >"$log_file"; then

        printf 'Forbidden first-party unsafe construct found.\n' >&2
        exit 1
      else
        rg_status="$?"
        if [ "$rg_status" -eq 1 ]; then
          :
        else
          cat "$log_file" >&2
          printf 'Unsafe audit scan failed with rg status %s.\n' "$rg_status" >&2
          exit "$rg_status"
        fi

    outputs:

    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:

      runInCI: true

      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'

  beads-server-mode:

tasks:
  fmt:
    command: 'rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo fmt --all --check'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  lint-src:
    script: |
      set -euo pipefail
      mkdir -p target/moon-locks
      mkdir -p target/tmp
      flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env TMPDIR="$PWD/target/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo clippy --quiet --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings -W clippy::all -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::panic_in_result_fn -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::string_slice -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::let_underscore_must_use -D clippy::await_holding_lock -D clippy::print_stdout -D clippy::print_stderr
    deps:
      - 'panic-surface'
      - 'ignored-fallible-results'
      - 'unsafe-audit'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  panic-surface:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-panic-surface.sh'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - 'scripts/check-panic-surface.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  ignored-fallible-results:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-ignored-fallible-results.sh'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - 'scripts/check-ignored-fallible-results.sh'
      - 'scripts/ignored-fallible-results.allow'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  unsafe-audit:
    script: |
      set -euo pipefail
      if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'Missing required scanner: rg\n' >&2
        exit 127
      fi
      mkdir -p target/static-audit
      unsafe_pattern='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])unsafe[[:space:]]*(\{|fn\b|trait\b|impl\b|extern\b|\()'
      log_file='target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log'
      if rg -n "$unsafe_pattern" crates --glob '*.rs' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/benches/**' --glob '!**/examples/**' --glob '!**/fixtures/**' --glob '!**/verification/**' --glob '!**/kani*/**' >"$log_file"; then
        cat "$log_file" >&2
        printf 'Forbidden first-party unsafe construct found.\n' >&2
        exit 1
      else
        rg_status="$?"
        if [ "$rg_status" -eq 1 ]; then
          :
        else
          cat "$log_file" >&2
          printf 'Unsafe audit scan failed with rg status %s.\n' "$rg_status" >&2
          exit "$rg_status"
        fi
      fi
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    outputs:
      - 'target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  check:
    script: |
      set -euo pipefail
      mkdir -p target/moon-locks
      mkdir -p target/tmp
      flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env TMPDIR="$PWD/target/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" timeout 10m rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo check --quiet --workspace --all-targets --all-features
    deps:
      - 'nightly-feature-gate'
      - 'agent-cli-contract'
      - 'beads-server-mode'
      - 'hot-cold-forbidden-apis'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  nightly-feature-gate:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-nightly-features.sh'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  # First-party feature-scope probe. Drives `cargo` (rather than a static
  # source scan) to enumerate the actually-compiled feature set under the
  # pinned nightly toolchain. Use this in addition to `nightly-feature-gate`
  # (which scans source for forbidden tokens). See bead vb-qblm4.
  nightly-feature-cargo-probe:
    script: |
      bash -c '
        set -euo pipefail
        rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo tree -p velvet-ballistics -e features \
          --all-features --format "{p} {f}" > /tmp/opencode/nightly-features.txt
        rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo metadata --format-version 1 \
          --all-features > /tmp/opencode/nightly-features-metadata.json
        echo "[nightly-feature-cargo-probe] OK: cargo-driven feature enumeration complete."
      '
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'Cargo.lock'
      - 'crates/**/Cargo.toml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  agent-cli-contract:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-agent-cli-contract.sh'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - 'crates/velvet_ballistics/src/**/*'
      - 'velvet-ballistics-MASTER.md'
      - 'scripts/check-agent-cli-contract.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  beads-server-mode:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-beads-server-mode.sh'
    inputs:
      - 'scripts/check-beads-server-mode.sh'
      - '.beads/metadata.json'
      - '.beads/config.yaml'
      - '.gitignore'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  blocker-closure-evidence:
    script: 'python scripts/check-vb-jpq7-closure-evidence.py --parent vb-jpq7 --bd-workdir "${VB_JPQ7_BD_WORKDIR:-/home/lewis/src/velvet-ballistics}"'
    inputs:
      - 'scripts/check-vb-jpq7-closure-evidence.py'
      - 'schemas/vb-jpq7-closure-evidence.schema.json'
      - 'docs/vb-jpq7-closure-evidence.md'
      - '.beads/vb-jpq7/closure-evidence-manifest.jsonl'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      cache: false
      runInCI: true

  workspace-assertions:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-workspace-assertions.sh'
    inputs:
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'scripts/check-workspace-assertions.rs'
      - 'scripts/check-workspace-assertions.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
      - 'crates/*/Cargo.toml'
      - 'crates/*/src/generated/**/*'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  test-integrity:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-test-integrity.sh'
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
      - 'scripts/check-test-integrity.rs'
      - 'scripts/check-test-integrity.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  test-determinism:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-test-determinism.sh'
    inputs:
      - 'scripts/check-test-determinism.py'
      - 'scripts/check-test-determinism.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
      - 'README.md'
      - 'crates/*/tests/**/*.rs'
      - 'crates/workspace_tests/src/**/*.rs'
    options:
      cache: false
      # Current tree has pre-existing findings; run explicitly until clean.
      runInCI: false

  banned-token-gates:
    deps:
      - 'panic-surface'
      - 'workspace-assertions'
      - 'ignored-fallible-results'
      - 'unsafe-audit'
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  hot-cold-forbidden-apis:
    command: 'bash scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.sh'
    inputs:
      - 'scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.rs'
      - 'scripts/check-hot-cold-forbidden-apis.sh'
      - 'scripts/hot-cold-forbidden-apis.allow'
      - 'crates/vb_core/src/**/*'
      - 'crates/vb_runtime/src/**/*'
      - 'crates/vb_storage/src/**/*'
      - 'crates/vb_ipc/src/**/*'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  source-length:

    command: 'bash scripts/check-source-length.sh'
    deps:
      - 'workspace-assertions'
      - 'banned-token-gates'
      - 'test-integrity'
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  hardened-build:
    script: |
      set -euo pipefail
      mkdir -p target/moon-locks
      mkdir -p target/tmp
      # Default CARGO_TARGET_DIR; --profile hardened is handled by Cargo's
      # profile fingerprint, so we keep dependency-graph cache hot with
      # `test`/`check`/`lint-src` even though the binary profile differs.
      flock --shared target/moon-locks/source-mutation.lock env TMPDIR="$PWD/target/tmp" RUSTC_WRAPPER= RUSTFLAGS="-Dwarnings" rustup run nightly-2026-04-28 cargo build --quiet -p velvet-ballistics --bin velvet-ballistics --all-features --profile hardened
    deps:
…
      - 'source-length'
…
      runInCI: true
…
      runInCI: true

      - 'panic-surface'
      - 'ignored-fallible-results'

    toolchains:

    toolchains:

    options:

      - rust
    inputs:

      - 'scripts/ignored-fallible-results.allow'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  unsafe-audit:
    script: |
      set -euo pipefail
      if ! command -v rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        printf 'Missing required scanner: rg\n' >&2
        exit 127
      fi
      mkdir -p target/static-audit
      unsafe_pattern='(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])unsafe[[:space:]]*(\{|fn\b|trait\b|impl\b|extern\b|\()'
      log_file='target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log'
      if rg -n "$unsafe_pattern" crates --glob '*.rs' --glob '!**/tests/**' --glob '!**/benches/**' --glob '!**/examples/**' --glob '!**/fixtures/**' --glob '!**/verification/**' --glob '!**/kani*/**' >"$log_file"; then
        cat "$log_file" >&2
        printf 'Forbidden first-party unsafe construct found.\n' >&2
        exit 1
      else
        rg_status="$?"
        if [ "$rg_status" -eq 1 ]; then
          :
        else
          cat "$log_file" >&2
          printf 'Unsafe audit scan failed with rg status %s.\n' "$rg_status" >&2
          exit "$rg_status"
        fi
      fi
    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'
    outputs:
      - 'target/static-audit/unsafe-audit.log'
    options:
      runInCI: true

    inputs:

    options:
      runInCI: true

    toolchains:

    inputs:
      - '@globs(sources)'
      - '@globs(tests)'
      - '@globs(configs)'
    options:
      runInCI: true

  # First-party feature-scope probe. Drives `cargo` (rather than a static

    toolchains:

    inputs:

    options:
      runInCI: true

    toolchains:
      - rust
    inputs:
      - 'crates/velvet_ballistics/src/**/*'
      - 'velvet-ballistics-MASTER.md'
      - 'scripts/check-agent-cli-contract.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'

      - 'scripts/check-workspace-assertions.sh'
      - '.moon/tasks/all.yml'

      - 'scripts/check-test-integrity.rs'
      - 'scripts/check-test-integrity.sh'

    options:
      runInCI: true

# Own-Branch Historical Audit — vb-fyktj

Audit scope: three historical own-branch commits compared against current main source. No shell execution. No broad verification. Per-hunk preservation analysis only.

## Patch 1: a46c3723dc — lint as_mut_slice (3 files)

### Hunk 1.1: crates/vb_ipc/src/frame_types.rs
Old: `let mut cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(&mut bytes[..]);`
Current (line 41): `let mut cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(bytes.as_mut_slice());`
Verdict: preserved_exact
Evidence: identical as_mut_slice() call at same logical location in encode() method.

### Hunk 1.2: crates/workspace_tests/src/test_util/fixture.rs
Old: `rng.fill(&mut vec[..]);`
Current (line 58): `rng.fill(vec.as_mut_slice());`
Verdict: preserved_exact
Evidence: identical as_mut_slice() call in build_bytes() method.

### Hunk 1.3: crates/workspace_tests/src/test_util/seed.rs
Old: `rng.fill(&mut bytes[..]);`
Current (line 23): `rng.fill(bytes.as_mut_slice());`
Verdict: preserved_exact
Evidence: identical as_mut_slice() call in SeededBytes::new() method.

## Patch 2: 62a2f47c2f — fuzz payload bound and profile comments

### Hunk 2.1: fuzz/fuzz_targets/vb_f04l_yaml_compiler_compile.rs
Old: Added doc comment with `-max_len=65536 -runs=100000` command hint.
Current (lines 1-3): Doc comment preserved exactly.
Verdict: preserved_exact

### Hunk 2.2: fuzz/fuzz_targets/yaml_events.rs
Old: Added doc comment with `-max_len=65536 -runs=100000` command hint.
Current (lines 1-7): Doc comment preserved exactly.
Verdict: preserved_exact

### Hunk 2.3: fuzz/src/yaml_target.rs
Old: `const MAX_FUZZ_PAYLOAD_USIZE: usize = 4096;` → `100_000`
Current (line 17): `const MAX_FUZZ_PAYLOAD_USIZE: usize = 100_000;`
Verdict: preserved_exact
Evidence: constant value matches; no subsequent regression detected.

## Patch 3: c56283c963 — corpora and dictionary smoke changes

### Hunk 3.1: fuzz corpus loading
Old: Added `if [ -d "fuzz/corpus/${fuzz_target}" ]; then cp -R ...`
Current (lines 578-580): Corpus loading preserved.
Verdict: preserved_exact

### Hunk 3.2: fuzz dictionary loading
Old: `dict_flag=""` shell variable approach with `split`-style positional arg.
Current (lines 581-586): Dictionary loading preserved but using bash array `fuzz_args+=()` with `-dict=` syntax.
Verdict: superseded_valid
Evidence: intent and behavior preserved; syntax modernized to array-based arg building. 8 .dict files exist (journal_event, kind_validation, vb_f04l_yaml_compiler_compile, vb_storage_codec, decode_record, expression, ipc_frame, journal_decode).

### Hunk 3.3: fuzz/corpus input dependency
Old: Added `'fuzz/corpus/**/*'` to inputs array.
Current (line 599): `'fuzz/corpus/**/*'` preserved in inputs.
Verdict: preserved_exact

## Overall

All 9 hunks across 3 patches have been preserved in current source. One hunk (dict loading syntax) was modernized to array-based syntax but maintains identical behavior. No missing, obsolete, or unsafe hunks detected. No inherited_unresolved from these three own-patches.

Context: Current main has newer fuzz child with actual 93 targets and 5 matching dictionaries. Earlier rawall8 dictionary parser probes also present. This audit covers only the three named own-patches; full v1 closure is not claimed.
